svg.title: Three ways to tokenize the same 12 values
svg.text: The same 12 values, three input styles (all settings illustrative)
each id selects one row of an embedding table (8 bins here; a table lookup, no arithmetic on the values)
6 patches, last one end-padded (dashed). Each patch of P values goes through a learned
projection to one d_model vector: no table. Without overlap and padding: 3 patches.
one token per time step; needs the largest lag (4) of history, so 8 of 12 steps
yield a token (dotted arrows: the lags feeding the last token).
